newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bankers Trust increases SHK Prop warrants.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust increases SHK Prop warrants.

text.p: Bankers Trust International Plc said on Thursday it would increase its 25.5 million American Style call warrants on Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd shares by a further 15 million warrants at HK$2.358 per warrant.
The new price compared to the already-issued warrants' closing price of HK$2.60 on Wednesday, Bankers Trust said. The price at issue in April was HK$1.974 per warrant.

Terms of the warrants remained unchanged. Ten warrants control one share at a strike price of HK$63.325 per share. The new warrants are expected to commence trading on October 4 and will expire on July 10, 1997. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
